[2026-01-07] worker/queue/consumer.py
The problem is message redelivery in the consumer. Worked in worker/queue/consumer.py today, background jobs side. This time it turned up only for users sitting in a negative UTC offset. Repro: kill the worker mid-batch and restart it. Root cause: schema drift between the migration and the model. Signal: the same message id handled more than once. Result: p99 latency fell from 6.7 s to 571 ms. Fix: regenerated the model from the migration and pinned the checksum (PR #2068 on branch fix/message-redelivery-1). Same corner of worker/queue/consumer.py as the earlier message redelivery work, so context carried over.
